title: 临时变更收款账户：制裁筛查、发票差异与押运放行
english: Last-minute beneficiary change, compliance hold and shipment release

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 8分钟：每个短语慢速三遍、正常三遍；标记重音并录音纠正。
lines: Beneficiary verification
收款人核验
Sanctions screening
制裁筛查
Ultimate beneficial owner
最终受益所有人
Document discrepancy
单证差异
Escalation deadline
升级处理截止时间
Payment instruction
付款指令

modules.title: 10个高频词组
modules.hint: 10分钟：每词用自己的话造一个矿业采购场景句。
lines: Know your customer, or KYC
了解你的客户，即客户尽职调查
Beneficiary name mismatch
收款人名称不匹配
Bank account amendment
银行账户变更
Independent callback verification
独立电话回拨核验
Sanctions screening hold
制裁筛查暂缓
Source of funds
资金来源
Supporting invoice
支持性发票
Payment cut-off
付款截止时间
Written authorization
书面授权
Audit trail
审计追踪记录

modules.title: 10个核心句
modules.hint: 10分钟：先朗读，再遮住英文翻译中文，最后模拟电话沟通。
lines: The beneficiary name does not match the signed contract.
收款人名称与已签合同不一致。
We cannot accept a bank account change by email alone.
我们不能仅凭电子邮件接受银行账户变更。
Please provide a signed amendment and updated bank confirmation.
请提供签署的变更文件和更新后的银行确认函。
We will verify the request through an independently confirmed contact.
我们将通过独立确认的联系方式核验该请求。
The payment is on hold pending compliance review.
付款正等待合规审核，暂时搁置。
Do not split the transfer to bypass screening.
不要拆分汇款以绕过筛查。
The supplier's shipment deadline does not override our controls.
供应商的发运期限不能凌驾于我们的控制程序之上。
Please reconcile the invoice, contract, and beneficiary details.
请核对发票、合同及收款人信息。
We will provide an update by two p.m. Kigali time.
我们将在基加利时间下午两点前更新进展。
Only an authorized signatory may approve the revised instruction.
只有获授权签字人才能批准修订后的付款指令。

modules.title: 金额吨位品位汇率口述
modules.hint: 8分钟：所有数字均为虚构教学数据；读出数值，明确金额、单位和计算逻辑。
lines: The lot weighs nine point six metric tonnes.
这批货重9.6公吨。
The agreed tantalum grade is twenty-seven point eight percent.
约定钽品位为27.8%。
The illustrative unit price is four dollars and seventy cents per MKU.
示例单价为每MKU 4.70美元。
The provisional invoice is twenty-eight thousand four hundred US dollars.
模拟暂定发票金额为28,400美元。
The proposed advance is forty percent, or eleven thousand three hundred and sixty dollars.
拟支付40%预付款，即11,360美元。
The illustrative exchange rate is one dollar to one thousand four hundred and eighty Rwandan francs.
模拟汇率为1美元兑1,480卢旺达法郎。
At that rate, the advance equals sixteen million eight hundred and twelve thousand eight hundred francs.
按该汇率，预付款为16,812,800卢旺达法郎。
Read the invoice number as INV zero two eight six, and the lot number as LOT zero seven four.
将发票号读作INV-0286，批次号读作LOT-074。

modules.title: Shadowing跟读
modules.hint: 6分钟：每句跟读五次，注意付款暂停与礼貌拒绝的语气。
lines: We received a request to change the beneficiary account shortly before the payment cut-off.
付款截止前不久，我们收到变更收款账户的请求。
Because the new beneficiary differs from the contract, we have temporarily suspended the transfer.
由于新收款人与合同不一致，我们已暂时中止转账。
Our team is verifying the request independently and will issue an update after compliance approval.
我们的团队正独立核验该请求，并将在合规批准后更新进展。

modules.title: Small Talk
modules.hint: 4分钟：两人对话，保持专业而不过度承诺。
lines: Good morning. Did your team complete the warehouse inspection?
早上好，你们团队完成仓库检查了吗？
Yes, the bags were counted and the lot was sealed.
完成了，吨包已清点，批次也已封存。
Thank you. I understand the truck is scheduled to leave this afternoon.
谢谢。我了解到卡车计划今天下午离开。
That is correct. We are waiting for payment confirmation.
没错，我们正在等待付款确认。
I will update you once the verification is complete.
核验完成后我会向你更新。

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 8分钟：压力点一，供应商要求改第三方账户；压力点二，发票金额与合同不符。给出拒绝与补救方案。
lines: The supplier requests payment to a newly nominated third-party account.
供应商要求将货款汇入新指定的第三方账户。
We cannot approve a third-party beneficiary without contractual justification and enhanced checks.
没有合同依据和强化核查，我们不能批准第三方收款人。
The invoice total differs from the purchase order by six hundred dollars.
发票总额与采购订单相差600美元。
Please issue a corrected invoice or a signed reconciliation statement.
请出具更正发票或签署的差异调节说明。
We will retain the payment hold until finance and compliance both sign off.
在财务和合规共同批准前，我们将维持付款暂停。
A supplier's verbal assurance is not sufficient evidence of account ownership.
供应商的口头保证不足以证明账户归属。

modules.title: 运输押运与海关
modules.hint: 7分钟：压力点三，押运司机催促放行；区分货物放行与资金支付。
lines: The truck is waiting at the secure dispatch area.
卡车正在安全发运区等候。
Please verify the seal number against the stuffing report.
请将封签号与装柜报告核对。
The packing list must match the verified net weight.
装箱单必须与核实的净重一致。
Do not release the shipment based solely on a payment screenshot.
不要仅凭付款截图放行货物。
The customs declaration and mineral traceability records must be consistent.
海关申报与矿产品溯源记录必须一致。
If the documentation is incomplete, escalate to the logistics manager before the truck departs.
如果文件不完整，请在车辆离开前升级给物流经理。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 15分钟：三轮各五分钟；每轮至少五句英文并明确行动、依据、截止时间。
lines: Round one: The supplier insists that the bank account change is urgent and threatens to cancel the deal.
第一轮：供应商坚称银行账户变更非常紧急，并威胁取消交易。
Model answer: We value the relationship, but we cannot transfer funds until the new beneficiary is independently verified.
示范回答：我们重视合作，但在新收款人完成独立核验前不能转账。
Round two: The bank flags a possible sanctions match and asks for additional documentation.
第二轮：银行提示可能命中制裁筛查并要求补充材料。
Model answer: We will submit the requested documents and wait for the bank's clearance; we will not reroute the payment to avoid screening.
示范回答：我们将提交要求的材料并等待银行放行，不会通过改道付款规避筛查。
Round three: The truck driver demands immediate release while the packing list shows an inconsistent weight.
第三轮：司机要求立即放行，但装箱单重量不一致。
Model answer: Please keep the truck secured while we reconcile the weighing record and obtain written release approval.
示范回答：请保持车辆安全停放，我们将核对称重记录并取得书面放行批准。

modules.title: 5句听写
modules.hint: 5分钟：先隐藏英文听读并默写，随后检查关键词。
lines: The beneficiary name does not match the contract.
收款人名称与合同不一致。
Please provide an updated bank confirmation.
请提供更新的银行确认函。
The payment remains on hold pending compliance review.
付款在合规审核期间继续暂缓。
We cannot bypass the sanctions screening process.
我们不能绕过制裁筛查流程。
The truck will depart only after written authorization.
车辆只有在取得书面授权后才能离开。

modules.title: 5道口语题
modules.hint: 5分钟：每题回答30至45秒，至少包括风险、控制和下一步。
lines: How would you verify a last-minute change of beneficiary?
你会如何核验最后一刻的收款人变更？
What would you tell a supplier who demands immediate payment?
供应商要求立即付款时你会怎么说？
How do you respond to a sanctions-screening hold?
你会如何应对制裁筛查暂缓？
What documents must match before an export shipment is released?
出口货物放行前哪些文件必须一致？
How do you communicate a deadline without promising an unapproved payment?
如何明确截止时间而不承诺未经批准的付款？

modules.title: 近期知识复习
modules.hint: 4分钟：回顾近期已有的封签、取样及水分争议主题，强调控制之间的关联。
lines: A sealed sample protects the integrity of an assay dispute.
封样可以保护化验争议中的样品完整性。
A moisture deduction must follow the agreed calculation method.
水分扣重必须遵循约定计算方法。
A seal discrepancy requires an evidence-based hold before release.
封签差异要求在放行前基于证据暂缓处理。
A beneficiary mismatch requires independent verification before payment.
收款人不匹配要求付款前进行独立核验。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 5分钟：先逐句点读，再脱稿做90秒工作汇报。
lines: Good morning. I would like to report an urgent payment and shipment-control issue involving a mineral purchase.
早上好，我要报告一项涉及矿产品采购的紧急付款与发运控制问题。
Shortly before the payment cut-off, the supplier requested a change to the beneficiary bank account.
在付款截止前不久，供应商要求变更收款银行账户。
The new beneficiary name does not match the signed contract, and the invoice amount also requires reconciliation.
新收款人名称与已签合同不一致，发票金额也需要核对。
We have placed the transfer on hold and requested a signed amendment, bank confirmation, and supporting invoice.
我们已暂缓转账，并要求提供签署的变更文件、银行确认函及支持性发票。
We will verify the request through an independently confirmed contact and complete the required compliance checks.
我们将通过独立确认的联系方式核验请求，并完成必要的合规检查。
Meanwhile, logistics is checking the seal, packing list, weighing record, and export documents before releasing the truck.
与此同时，物流部门正在核对封签、装箱单、称重记录和出口文件，之后才会放行车辆。
We understand the commercial urgency, but we will not bypass bank screening or internal authorization controls.
我们理解商业上的紧迫性，但不会绕过银行筛查或内部授权控制。
We will provide a factual update by two p.m. Kigali time, without promising an unapproved transfer.
我们将在基加利时间下午两点前提供事实进展，但不会承诺未经批准的转账。
Thank you. I will document the decision and keep all relevant teams informed.
谢谢。我将记录决策，并持续通知所有相关团队。

I resolved three pressure scenarios without bypassing controls.
我在不绕过控制程序的情况下处理了三个高压情境。
I completed the dictation, speaking questions, review, and final briefing.
我完成了听写、口语题、复习和完整工作陈述。
